spectrum: Reuse archived phase20; no full-spectrum array is archived, so reconstruct exactly the original linear detrend, periodic Hann512, FFT4096 at20Hz. Match all156 original predictions exactly.
stage_order: Commit protocol/code; run radar-only catalogue; hash and commit all radar outputs; only then read existing ECG window references for annotation. Preserve each stage.
retention: All78 windows per record, including any invalid flags; no outcome-based removal. Existing zero-offset predictions and scores retained. Two records belong to one subject, windows overlap.
full_peak_catalogue: scipy.find_peaks on full original0-600bpm power, save every local maximum with prominence,width and plateau. Include one-sided full-spectrum endpoint maxima with undefined prominence. Add cropped-band endpoint maxima not already full peaks, labelled crop_endpoint_only.
amplitude: Coherent amplitude proxy2*sqrt(power)/sum(periodicHann512), including endpoints for a uniform diagnostic scale. Save original power as well.
rankings: Freeze full-spectrum local-peak rank, in-band full-local-peak rank and cropped-peak rank by descending power, ties by ascending bin. Crop rank includes artificial endpoint maxima. Main/second amplitude and power ratios for full and cropped lists.
boundary: Exact crop endpoints and regions within2.34375bpm of45 or150. Genuine peak requires membership in the full-spectrum local maxima, independent of the crop.
truncated_flank: Exact lower crop endpoint, not a full local maximum, with strictly higher left neighbor and lower/equal right neighbor => lower_cut_descending_flank. Upper endpoint symmetric. Save nearest outside full local maximum and whether the intervening sequence is monotone.
radar_candidate_gate: In-band full-spectrum local maximum; amplitude>=0.10*original cropped winner; full-spectrum prominence>=0.10*own power; own power>=3*median in-band power. Save individual flags and raw values for all peaks. This is an operational discernibility convention.
annotation: After radar commit, attach existing primary ECG window reference at0s and annotate every frozen peak with signed/absolute distance, ranks and raw error. Label never changes a radar gate or peak set.
error_window: Finite primary reference and abs(original prediction-reference)>2.34375bpm. Also report >5bpm stratum. Retain original radar_valid/common_support flags.
boundary_hidden_candidate: Error window; original winner in boundary region; radar-qualified in-band peak within2.34375bpm of reference, distinct from winner by>2.34375bpm. Count cut-flank and genuine-boundary-winner cases separately. Secondary5bpm matches are descriptive and cannot substitute for main gate.
interpretation: ECG-matched candidates are posthoc diagnostic annotations on a frozen radar catalogue, not an alternative deployed prediction. Candidate coincidences need cautious interpretation if many peaks. Use records as descriptive units; no window-level significance.
focus_objects: Reuse exact two registered transitions from ellipse_applicability/future_peak_readout_objects.json. Apply same rules to their four adjacent window starts and all remaining windows.
exit: Qualified ECG-near distinct peaks in actual boundary-error windows support a later single-factor readout study, with evidence split by record and registered events. If absent, do not attribute those errors to maximum-peak choice. Preserve original predictions/scoring; no readout modification this round.
scope: One local diagnostic on the two archived accepted real records. Existing six remain development material; other27 retained. Synthetic mechanism branch closed.
